dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp gradient transitions from a low-intensity dark gray base to high-intensity light gray perimeters. The most prominent structures include a closed vertically-oriented oval on the posterior-lateral flank and a large, irregular 'C' shaped loop on the mid-dorsal curve.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity light gray spots lacking internal gradients are concentrated around the cephalic and cervical regions, with lower spatial density observed along the ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface form a scalene triangle with the most obtuse angle oriented toward the anterior-dorsal peak.
